name: Fort Drum
tagline: Home of the 10th Mountain Division, a deploy-ready light infantry post in New York's snowy North Country.
_note: Army post (North Country NY, near Watertown / Jefferson County). Famous for heavy lake-effect snow. Facts verified from official sources (home.army.mil/drum, guthrie clinic, fortdrummch.com, DeCA/AAFES, Wikipedia for corroborated headline facts). BAH MHA NY225 (Fort Drum/Watertown) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing: Fort Drum Mountain Community Homes (Lendlease sold its military housing business in 2025; Military OneSource pages conflict on the new partner). New York is TRICARE East. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 13601 (Watertown). Rechecked 2026-11-12 (research/drum-facts.md): on-post neighborhood sets Carthage vs Indian River; 2025 NYSED graduation rates read directly; gates per home.army.mil 11/9/26; VTL 251 for nonresident cars; no hospital on post.

data.Location: Near Watertown, NY (North Country, Jefferson County)

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Drum is home to the 10th Mountain Division (Light Infantry), reactivated here in 1985. Military OneSource counts more than 15,000 service members and 18,613 family members.
It sits in New York's rural North Country near Watertown, between Lake Ontario, the Thousand Islands, and the Adirondacks, a setting defined by serious winters and abundant outdoor recreation.

sections.title: Which School District? Living Near Fort Drum

data.subtitle: The school district behind an address matters more than the town name. It sets both the schools and the school tax, and one town can sit in several districts.
intro: On post, the neighborhood decides the schools: Rhicard Hills attends Carthage, and Adirondack Creek, Crescent Woods and Monument Ridge attend Indian River. Off post, one town can sit in up to four school districts, so check the district on the tax bill, not the town name.

School taxes differ widely by our reading: the state's 2025 STAR credits run about $71 to $80 for Indian River addresses, $165 to $177 for Carthage addresses and $253 to $298 in the Watertown City, General Brown, Sackets Harbor and South Jefferson districts. STAR goes only to owners who live in the home as their primary residence. Graduation rates (2025) are Carthage 95%, Indian River 92%, General Brown 96%, Sackets Harbor 93%, South Jefferson 90% and Watertown City 82% (up from 69% in 2024), against 85% statewide.

recommendations.advice: Evans Mills and Calcium are about 6 minutes from the Cerjan / Main Gate, Black River about 5 from Plummer Gate and Watertown about 10, with no traffic.

Indian River district addresses have the area's lowest 2025 STAR school tax credits (about $71 to $80) and graduated 92% in 2025. Carthage district credits are about $165 to $177 (95% graduation); Watertown-area districts about $253 to $298.

Fort Drum Mountain Community Homes runs 3,793 homes with two to five bedrooms. Rhicard Hills attends Carthage schools; the other three neighborhoods attend Indian River. We found no official wait times, so start the advanced application early.

Watertown's average January low is 10 degrees, snow can fall from October into April, and the Tug Hill Plateau just south averages more than 300 inches of lake-effect snow. Free winter driving courses are offered on post.

source.label: NYS Tax Department, 2025 STAR credits, Jefferson County

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: The Cerjan / Main Gate, at the end of I-781 from I-81 Exit 48A, is open 24/7 and has the Visitor Control Center (Building 11008, 5:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily, 315-772-8585). The Wheeler-Sack Army Airfield Gate is open 24/7 for commercial traffic and airfield staff; the Army asks others to use Cerjan or Plummer. Plummer Gate, near Black River, is open 4:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. and was set to close from November 25 to 30, 2026 and from December 20, 2026 to January 3, 2027. Gasoline Alley Gate closed on June 5, 2026 for construction and is listed as closed until further notice.
Visitors need a REAL ID and agree to a background check. Gate status changes, so confirm on the official Fort Drum site before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: Fort Drum Mountain Community Homes runs 3,793 family homes with two to five bedrooms in Adirondack Creek, Crescent Woods, Monument Ridge and Rhicard Hills (315-955-6644). A $10 million roofing project for about 600 homes in Monument Ridge and Rhicard Hills, plus the Timbers, was planned for summer 2026.

We found no official wait times; Military OneSource encourages the advanced application. Housing Services Office (off-post help): Clark Hall, Building 10720, Room A2-54, 315-772-6668. Army Housing Office: 315-772-3008. Housing Concerns Hotline: 315-772-6666, option 1. The Timbers has 192 apartments for single and unaccompanied soldiers, staff sergeant (E-6) and above.

source.label: DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA NY225 (Fort Drum/Watertown)

sections.title: Schools
data: There are no schools on Fort Drum and no DoD schools. Rhicard Hills attends the Carthage Central School District; Adirondack Creek, Crescent Woods and Monument Ridge attend Indian River Central. Off post, addresses can also fall in Watertown City, General Brown, Sackets Harbor, South Jefferson and other districts.

Graduation rates, 4-year outcome as of August 2025 (NYSED): General Brown 96%, Carthage 95%, Sackets Harbor 93%, Indian River 92%, South Jefferson 90%, Watertown City 82%; statewide 85%. School Liaison: 315-772-3214.

data.Care: Outpatient care on post (11050 Mount Belvedere Blvd, 315-772-2778, weekdays 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.). There is no hospital on post: emergency rooms at Samaritan Medical Center in Watertown and Carthage Area Hospital, and inpatient care mainly at Samaritan.

source.label: Military OneSource, Fort Drum health care

data.Commissary: Fort Drum Commissary, 10730C Enduring Freedom Drive, open 7:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and the answer is mostly about how long you'll be here and how steady the local market is.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the area and a North Country winter before committing.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
You've confirmed the school district, and so the school tax, for the exact address.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. Jefferson County home values rose 6.0% in the year to September 2026 (Zillow), listings rose about 10% from October 2025 to October 2026, and winter listings run about half the summer peak. Report to the Housing Services Office before making arrangements for any off-post lease or purchase (the Army requires it), run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Start the advanced application for on-post housing, and report to the Housing Services Office (Clark Hall, Building 10720, Room A2-54) before you make arrangements to rent, lease or buy off post; the Army requires it.

steps.title: Sort your vehicle and base access
steps.text: If your legal residence is another state, New York's registration rules don't apply to your car with current home-state registration and plates; a car on military-issued plates is covered for only 45 days. Visitors need a REAL ID and agree to a background check at the Visitor Control Center (Building 11008, 5:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily, 315-772-8585).

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: On post, Rhicard Hills attends Carthage schools and Adirondack Creek, Crescent Woods and Monument Ridge attend Indian River. Off post, check the district on the tax bill. School Liaison: 315-772-3214.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Guthrie Army Health Clinic or Samaritan Medical Center.

data.a: The 10th Mountain Division (Light Infantry), with more than 15,000 service members (Military OneSource).

Long and cold: Watertown's average January low is 10 degrees, snow can fall from October into April, and Watertown got 57.4 inches in one November 2022 storm. For post delays and closures, call 315-772-3786.

On post (3,793 homes), or in Watertown, Evans Mills, Calcium, Black River, Carthage and the villages around them. Check the school district for any address: Indian River and Carthage serve the post, and Watertown City, General Brown, Sackets Harbor and South Jefferson serve other addresses.
Fort Drum is MHA NY225 (Fort Drum/Watertown). Use the calculator above for your grade.

data.q: Does New York tax my military pay?
data.a: Only if New York is your legal residence. A nonresident's military pay isn't taxed, nor the New York wages of a spouse whose legal residence isn't New York and who is here only to be with the service member on military orders. Military retirement pay is exempt, and sales tax is 8% in Jefferson County.

data.q: Which school district will my children attend on post?
data.a: Rhicard Hills attends the Carthage Central School District (95% graduation in 2025); Adirondack Creek, Crescent Woods and Monument Ridge attend Indian River Central (92%). There are no schools on post.
